name: Cupid's Bargain
storyline:
A self-proclaimed matchmaker who has never experienced love summons a pair of demonic deities to spruce up her dying school extracurricular because, like, who really needs a soul anyway? Together, they will settle a toxic love affair disturbing her school life all while helping her understand love itself...

...and selling souls in the meantime.

Just another day at your all-girls Catholic high school!
summary: Cupid's Bargain is a horror, romcom visual novel that is centered on a self-proclaimed matchmaker who has never experienced love! So, what does she do to remedy that? She summons a pair of demonic deities because, like, who really needs a soul anyway? Together, they will settle a toxic love affair disturbing her school life all while helping her understand love itself... and selling souls in the meantime.
